exact_target: Literal prescribed full H=Z plus finite T and ordinary integral free-abelian Alexander polynomial, closed connected oriented 3-manifolds; Turaev Conjecture 12.26, printed542/PDF170.
submitted_contributions: Integral connected-cut square-presentation and specialization proof.
General mod-p bound ord_1(Delta mod p) >= dim_Fp(T tensor Fp).
Explicit family H=Z plus (Z/p)^3, Delta=t+(p^3-2)+t^-1 refuting literal sufficiency.
initial_findings: Actual primary pixels II.3.2 p22 establish integrality of the polynomial part of refined torsion; II.3.3 p23 places it in product of ideals (I(H),p_i), omitting the first two finite invariant factors.

Actual primary formula II.5.b p28 for closed b1=1 expresses ordinary integral Alexander polynomial as pr(polynomial torsion)*(t-1)*(t^-1-1) minus |T| times an integral Laurent unit. Definitions p27 and Massuyeau12-13 retain integer content.

For T=(Z/p)^3, II.3.3 gives pr(polynomial torsion) mod p divisible by t-1. II.5.b therefore makes Delta mod p divisible by (t-1)^3. Submitted family reduces to t^-1(t-1)^2. Contradiction is an immediate old mathematical consequence for every prime.

The same source mechanism yields the full stated bound: r>=3 gives r-2 ideal factors and two polynomial factors; r=1,2 follows integrality and p|T|; r=0 is trivial. Thus no stronger submitted inequality has yet escaped the published result.
III.4.3 p46 alone cannot justify p=2 for this family: it requires H/4 free over Z/4, which fails. Integral II.3.3 has no such restriction.
VIII.5.4 p118 realizes the polynomial using cyclic finite torsion. It does not prescribe (Z/p)^3. VIII.5.2 p114 is conditional on an already realizable torsion and is not universal realization.

No earlier express named refutation of Conjecture12.26 established by these pages; possibly new bibliographic application and new presentation of proof must remain distinct from new mathematical obstruction.
falsification_targets: Whether units/Euler signs or primitive-content conventions allow the family.
Whether the general rank inequality is stronger than II.3.3 plus II.5.b.
Whether full prescribed torsion is incorrectly replaced by cyclic torsion.
Whether closing language asserts prior express refutation or universal absence of novelty.
Whether user-scoped no novel-solution paper closure is supported even if bibliographic application may be new.
